data.title: Clas Ohlson Appoints Nomination Committee Ahead of 2027 AGM
data.description:
Clas Ohlson AB ( ($SE:CLAS.B) ) has shared an announcement.

Clas Ohlson has appointed its Nomination Committee ahead of the 2027 Annual General Meeting, with Malin Persson representing the Haid owner family as chair, Johan Ståhl representing the Tidstrand owner family, and Nordea Fonder and Swedbank Robur Fonder also represented. Board Chairman Kenneth Bengtsson is co-opted to the committee.

The committee is tasked with submitting proposals on the Board, its chair, auditors and related fees and remuneration at the forthcoming meeting. Based on ownership as of 30 September 2026, it represents approximately 71 per cent of voting power; the Annual General Meeting will be held on 10 September 2027, and the committee remains in place until a new one is appointed.

data.title: Vidrala Announces Trading of New Bonus Shares From 23 November
data.description:
Vidrala ( (ES:VID) ) has issued an update.

CNMV approved the admission to trading of 1,760,312 new ordinary Vidrala shares issued through a €1,795,518.24 capital increase charged against freely distributable reserves. The shares will be allocated free of charge at a ratio of one new share for every 20 existing shares and will trade on the Bilbao and Madrid exchanges from 23 November 2026, while registration of the capital-increase deed with the Álava Commercial Registry remains pending.

data.title: Proteomics International Reports Annual Meeting Resolution Outcomes
data.description:
Proteomics International Laboratories Ltd. ( (AU:PIQ) ) has provided an announcement.

Proteomics International Laboratories is a medical technology company focused on precision diagnostics and bio-analytical services, with expertise in proteomics, the industrial-scale study of protein structure and function. At its annual general meeting on 20 November 2026, members considered nine resolutions covering director elections, remuneration-related matters, placement capacity and SPP options, while the non-binding remuneration report vote recorded 51.85% for and 48.15% against.

The re-election of Paul House and the issue of director shares in lieu of cash STI to David Morris were carried, while James Williams’s re-election, two proposals concerning David Morris’s sign-on rights and performance rights, additional 10% placement capacity, and both SPP option issuance resolutions were not carried. The company also said Aaron Brinkworth had been appointed chair while the Board reviewed the meeting outcomes.

data.title: Oyak Yatırım Ortaklığı Reports TRY 9.00 Net Asset Value Per Share
data.description:
Oyak Yatirim Ortakligi Anonim Sirketi ( (TR:OYAYO) ) has issued an announcement.

As of 19 November 2026, Oyak Yatırım Ortaklığı’s net asset value per share was TRY 9.00, while the weighted average price of its shares on Borsa İstanbul was TRY 32.03, exceeding twice the net asset value per share. The company disclosed its sector-based portfolio and net asset value statement to shareholders, investors and the public under the applicable Capital Markets Board disclosure requirement.

The requirement calls for daily publication of the sector-based portfolio and net asset value statement from the next business day until the price condition no longer applies. The statement reported a total portfolio value of TRY 181.79 million and total value of TRY 180.07 million, with total value per share at TRY 9.00.

data.title: Saniona Appoints Carrie Cook as Chief Business Officer
data.description:
Saniona AB ( (SE:SANION) ) has shared an announcement.

Saniona, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on neurological and psychiatric disorders, appointed Carrie Cook as chief business officer. She will lead global business development, partnering and alliance management as the company advances its SAN2668 and SAN2465 programs toward clinical trials.

Cook brings more than 25 years of global business development experience across pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, most recently as Sitryx’s chief business officer. Her appointment gives Saniona an executive responsible for business development, partnering and alliance management as its proprietary neurology programs approach Phase 1 trials.

data.title: Kobe Bussan Reports October 2026 Monthly Performance
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Kobe Bussan Co., Ltd. ( (JP:3038) ).

Kobe Bussan, whose release covers the Gyomu Super store network, reported non-consolidated October 2026 sales of ¥52,108 million, up 3.9% year over year. Gross profit was ¥5,278 million, up 2.8%, while operating profit fell 7.8% to ¥2,344 million and ordinary profit increased 43.7% to ¥3,272 million.

During October, seven Gyomu Super stores opened—five in directly managed areas and two in indirectly managed areas—with no closures, taking total stores to 1,157. Nationwide product shipments to all stores rose 3.7% year over year, while full-year figures showed sales up 5.2%, operating profit down 0.2% and ordinary profit down 3.1%; the monthly figures are unaudited and subject to revision.
